title: Consolidate the two divergent arb_parity_check.dart implementations
rule: AG-1 (route through committed scripts; no ad-hoc variants) / Rule 0
why: Two independently-maintained copies of the same nominal checker exist: root Makefile's `arb-parity` target runs tool/arb_parity_check.dart (repo-root paths, --en/--he flags, try/catch around JSON parse errors returning exit 2 with a clear message), while .github/workflows/ci.yml's arb-parity job runs `dart run tool/arb_parity_check.dart` from `working-directory: learning_tracker`, resolving to the DIFFERENT learning_tracker/tool/arb_parity_check.dart (learning_tracker-relative paths, no flags, uncaught jsonDecode exceptions crash with a raw stack trace instead of a clean exit(2)+message). Both currently pass because each is correctly paired with its own CWD, but a future fix to one (e.g. better error messages, a new --strict flag) has no reason to land in the other, and the two already silently diverge in behavior on the identical malformed-JSON failure mode.
recommendation: Delete one copy and have both call sites invoke the same script (e.g. keep only learning_tracker/tool/arb_parity_check.dart and have the root Makefile's arb-parity target `cd learning_tracker &&` into it).
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one arb_parity_check.dart exists in the repo, and both the root Makefile target and CI's arb-parity job invoke it.
mergedFrom: Route hooks/pre-commit's format/analyze calls through committed make targets instead of inlining them
